source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Morgan's discovery of sex linkage (PDF 105-106).

blocks.text: 1910 mein Thomas Hunt Morgan ko aik nar Drosophila mili jis ki aankhein normal surkh ke bajaye safaid theen. Us ne is mutant nar ko normal (wild-type) surkh aankh wali maada se milaya aur sab F1 makkhiyon ki aankhein surkh theen, is liye surkh safaid par dominant tha.

Phir us ne surkh aankh wali F1 makkhiyan aapas mein milayin. Kitab F2 mein 3473 surkh aankh wali (nar aur maada) aur 782 safaid aankh wali makkhiyan batati hai, taqreeban 18%. Surkh aur safaid ki nisbat 3:1 se zyada thi, lekin ahem baat yeh thi ke sab safaid aankh wali F2 makkhiyan nar theen.

blocks.alt: Teen crosses, makkhiyon ki aankhein surkh ya safaid. 1: surkh maada XR XR x safaid nar Xr Y se surkh XR Xr betiyan aur surkh XR Y bete. 2: F1 x F1 se XR XR, XR Xr, XR Y (surkh) aur Xr Y (safaid), 3 surkh : 1 safaid, sab safaid nar. 3: safaid maada Xr Xr x surkh nar XR Y se surkh betiyan aur safaid bete. Neeche: 3473 surkh aur 782 safaid F2 makkhiyon ki patti.
blocks.caption: Safaid aankh wali Drosophila ke saath Morgan ke crosses (Figure 18.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Morgan ne safaid aankh wale nar ko surkh aankh wali maada se milaya aur sab surkh aankh wala F1 paya. F1 x F1 ke F2 mein dono jinson ki 3473 surkh aankh wali aur 782 safaid aankh wali makkhiyan milin, sab safaid nar. F1 surkh maada aur safaid nar ke testcross se surkh aur safaid maada aur nar 1:1:1:1 mein aaye, jis se sabit hua ke safaid aankh wali maada ho sakti hai, aur safaid maada x surkh nar se surkh betiyan aur safaid bete hue. Yeh sab tab theek baithta hai jab aankh ke rang ka gene X chromosome par ho aur Y par us ka koi allele na ho: nar mein aik hi X hai, is liye aik recessive allele us mein zahir ho jata hai. Note: 3473 + 782 = 4255 hai, jab ke kitab 4252 chhapti hai; 782 dono majmooon ka taqreeban 18% hai.

blocks.text: Yeh jaanchne ke liye ke kya safaid aankh wali maada ho sakti hai, Morgan ne F1 surkh aankh wali maada ka safaid aankh wale nar se testcross kiya aur safaid aur surkh aankh wale nar aur maada 1:1:1:1 mein paye, yaani maada ki aankhein safaid ho sakti hain. Phir us ne safaid aankh wali maada ko surkh aankh wale nar se milaya: sab betiyon ki aankhein surkh aur sab beton ki safaid theen.

blocks.title: Morgan ka nateeja
blocks.text: Safaid aankh ka gene X chromosome par hai, aur Y chromosome par is ka allele nahi. Morgan ne aise genes ko sex-linked genes aur khasiyaton ko sex-linked khasiyatein kaha.

blocks.title: Adaad ki jaanch
blocks.text: 3473 + 782 = 4255 hai, jab ke kitab kul 4252 chhapti hai; 782 dono majmooon ka taqreeban 18% hai.

blocks.prompt: Morgan ki sab safaid aankh wali F2 makkhiyan nar kyun nikleen?
blocks.explanation: F1 maada XR Xr aur F1 nar XR Y tha. Har beti ko baap ka XR mila, is liye sab surkh aankh wali; aadhe beton ko maa ka Xr mila aur doosra X na hone se un ki aankhein safaid hueen.

items: Morgan 1910: safaid aankh nar x surkh maada se sab surkh F1.
F2: 3473 surkh, 782 safaid, sab safaid nar.
Safaid maada x surkh nar: surkh betiyan, safaid bete; gene X par, Y par nahi.
